note: Triennial election of the county council, 1964: polled 4 June 1964 in Lurgan and Crossmaglen; the other 18 divisions (19 seats) returned unopposed. The nominations list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Described as "the Unionist chairman of the City Council", returned unopposed (Armagh Guardian, 21 May 1964, p. 1); Thomas McLaughlin, Nationalist, did not stand against him.
